name: AMC Paper
description: An editorial style for reports and document-heavy apps: near-white paper, ink-black text, one strong ink-blue accent, serif headings and hairline rules instead of boxes.
fonts: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif (page and region titles)
helpText: Light style built on Vita for reports and document-heavy apps. The page is near-white paper with ink-black text; the only accent is a strong ink blue (WCAG AA with white text) used for hot buttons, links, the current menu entry and focus; red is kept for danger only, so a hot button never reads as destructive. Regions drop their boxes: no fill change, no shadow, square corners and a solid ink rule on top, with hairline rules between rows. Page and region titles use the system serif stack (Georgia, Times New Roman); body text stays on the system sans stack for dense data. The header is paper with a double rule like a masthead. Header and navigation refinements target Universal Theme classes and should be checked on a live page.
